svg.title: GS1-128 logistic label with SSCC, GS1 DataMatrix part mark and RFID read zones LF HF UHF – identification example
svg.text: Identification – GS1 logistic label (SSCC in GS1-128), GS1 DataMatrix part mark, RFID read zones (example values)

GS1 prefix 952 = reserved for demonstration (guide 15 §3.16) – never print it on real labels. Bar code below is encoded with the Code 128 tables (set C + FNC1); verify any real label with a verifier (ISO/IEC 15416).
GS1-128: start C, FNC1, 10 digit pairs, check value 83, stop
A6 logistic label 105 × 148 mm (GS1 logistic label layout)
SSCC symbol: 156 modules + 2 × 10 quiet zone; at X = 0.495 mm ≈ 87 mm wide
min. bar height for the SSCC ≈ 32 mm (check GS1 General Specifications)
GS1 DataMatrix – direct part mark on the crankcase
Laser or dot-peen on the cast surface; check
DataMatrix on parts and small labels (camera readers),
damage tolerant up to ≈ 25–30 % with ECC 200.
RFID read zones (typical, depend on tag, antenna, metal)
λ = 0.346 m; EIRP 3.28 W (2 W ERP, EU), G_tag 1.58:
d = 3 m → −2.6 dBm; tag chip −18 dBm → d_max ≈ 16 m
in free space. Real: 3–8 m (metal, liquids, angle).
Use on-metal tags on steel crates / fixture pallets;
portal at the FG AS/RS in-feed reads 1 crate per pass.
